title: introduce preflight validation job and atomic rollback hook for private chart
author: Asha Patel
description: Add a configurable preflight validation job and an atomic rollback hook to the private Helm chart. Motivation: private deployments (VPC / on-prem) often fail during upgrades due to cluster-level preconditions (storageClass mismatches, missing CRDs, networkPolicy constraints) and we lacked a deterministic, observable rollback path when post-install health checks fail. This PR introduces: 1) charts/private/templates/preflight-job.yaml - a templated Job that runs as a pre-install/upgrade hook when values.hooks.preflight.enabled=true; it validates K8s resources, required Secrets, and optionally probes a set of service endpoints listed in values.hooks.preflight.endpoints. 2) charts/private/templates/hooks/rollback-atomic.yaml - a hook that runs on hook failure and attempts a best-effort cleanup and forces a rollback (uses Helm annotations and a short lived Pod with the helm rollback helper script). 3) values.schema.json additions to validate new hook values (timeouts, retries, endpoint list, runPolicy). 4) migration notes and a small helper template (charts/private/templates/_helpers-hooks.tpl) so downstream overlays can reuse the hook annotations. 5) docs: charts/private/README-hooks.md with examples and recommended preflight checks for common on-prem environments. 6) e2e smoke test harness update and a unit test for the template logic. Backwards compatibility: hooks are opt-in (default disabled) and will not change behavior for existing installs. The description below includes high-level commit summary, changed files, CI status and the review thread. NOTE: all explanatory content is contained in a single continuous string per repo policy.

review_comments: Jun Park: Can we add a shorter default timeout for the preflight job in heavily constrained on-prem clusters? Suggest default 60s per endpoint and total job timeout of 5m.
Asha Patel: Updated defaults in values.yaml and adjusted schema to enforce maximum of 15m per job. Added note in README explaining tradeoffs between endpoint timeouts and overall job runtime.

Miguel Hernandez: The rollback hook looks helpful, but we should ensure it only triggers after a failed post-install hook and not on transient CI failures. Add guard using helm.sh/hook-delete-policy: hook-succeeded
Asha Patel: Added guard, and added a small backoff/retry loop inside the rollback helper script to avoid racing with kube-apiserver during large cluster upgrades.
Emily Chen: Can the preflight job be gated by a feature flag so operators can test without enabling automatic rollbacks? Also request a brief security review for the helper script execution context.

Asha Patel: Preflight is opt-in by default; added note and example for staged rollout. Security review: helper script runs as non-root and we documented required RBAC in README; Security scan CI added a warning for elevated privileges and we adjusted to minimize permissions.

Jun Park (approve): LGTM after defaults/guard changes and docs. Miguel Hernandez (approve): tested on lab cluster (k8s 1.26) and validated rollback path. Emily Chen (approve): Docs and security notes look good.

release_notes: Add optional preflight validation job and an atomic rollback hook for Private Helm chart. Hooks are disabled by default. Operators can enable hooks.hooks.preflight and configure timeouts/endpoints. Improves upgrade safety for on-prem and VPC deployments.
